title: Biased probability of a fixed-length window
statement: Let $\rho\in\bbr$, let $s,T,m$ be natural numbers with $s+T\le m$, and let $B$ be a predicate on Boolean words. The biased probability that $B$ holds of the length-$T$ segment obtained by dropping the first $s$ bits and then taking the first $T$ bits of a sampled length-$m$ word equals the biased probability that $B$ holds of a sampled length-$T$ word.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a predicate on Boolean words
